subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window into a compact one-line summary, and accepting this issue would add a new public Telegram streaming lifecycle/config policy rather than fix broken documented behavior.

options.title: Accept default-off full-draft retention
options.body: Add a documented Telegram progress finalization option, keep the current collapse summary as the default, and require focused tests plus real Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep the current collapse summary
options.body: Decline full completed-draft preservation and treat the current final answer plus one-line activity digest as the supported Telegram progress lifecycle.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Hold the Telegram-specific option until a cross-channel structured progress-card/checklist API is designed.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off full-draft retention
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram progress finalization option, keep the current collapse summary as the default, and require focused tests plus real Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most targeted recent history on the Telegram collapse-bar fallback path that this product decision would change.
